title: Settings
deleteAllWorkoutsMessage: This will permanently delete all your workout history and sets. This cannot be undone.
deletePreloadedExercisesMessage: This will permanently delete all built-in exercises. Your custom exercises will not be affected.
deleteCustomExercisesMessage: This will permanently delete all exercises you have created. Pre-loaded exercises will not be affected.

workoutPrefs.compoundInfoMessage: Compound exercises work multiple muscle groups and joints at once (e.g. squats, bench press, deadlifts). They're the foundation of most sessions.
workoutPrefs.accessoryInfoMessage: Accessory exercises support your main lifts by targeting supporting muscle groups (e.g. rows, lunges, dips). They round out a session and help fix weak points.
workoutPrefs.isolationInfoMessage: Isolation exercises target a single muscle and joint (e.g. bicep curls, leg extensions). They're used to build size or address specific weaknesses.
workoutPrefs.progressRepsInfoMessage: The rep target that triggers a weight increase. Once you hit this many reps on a set, the app suggests adding weight next time — until then, it suggests adding reps.
workoutPrefs.setsPerExerciseInfoMessage: How many sets are pre-filled with suggested weight and reps whenever you open an exercise during a workout. You can always add or remove sets on the fly.
workoutPrefs.weeklyGoalInfoMessage: How many workouts per week count toward your streak goal. Shown on Home as your weekly progress.
